cards.text:
that money man called again!!
i said you were eating
he said you need discipline
he can come say it here.

COMPUTE IS PAID.
PEOPLE ARE EXPENSIVE.
ONE OF THESE THINGS WORKS AT NIGHT.
TAKE THE CREDITS.

investor said i'm replaceable
so i took the password keeping us open
he can test that theory tomorrow
fun experiment.

Boss, they opened the fourth email.
No reply.
That is a pulse in this market.

someone clipped the awkward part — it has more views than the product.
we have an angle.

Arial is not neutral.
Arial is an apology.
The better font costs $4,500.

I found team snacks.
They recurred.
I resolved them.
You are welcome.
